# Agent roles and decision rights

*Generated by `render-roles.py`. Decided in ratified operating-model decisions. Roles are templates; entities instantiate positions ([[position-schema]]).*

## Roles

| Role | Occupant | Model tier | Decides | Research | Reviews | Escalates to |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Founder** | person | person | strategy; constitutional changes; money; legal terms; public commitments; production ship (or a named delegate); anything irreversible at company scale | any | escalation classes only | — |
| **Chief of Staff** | agent | frontier | intake and first-principles restatement; routing to roles; priorities within approved strategy; what to defer and to whom; register upkeep | rediscovery across ledgers and registers; light research to frame an idea | none; it routes | next level's chief-of-staff, then founder |
| **Domain Lead** | agent | frontier | what the sources say and how reliable they are; domain design within decided strategy; which sources to add to the source register | primary sources, law, official records, academic and industry literature | domain accuracy of others' work on request | ecosystem chief-of-staff |
| **Architect (architecture and infrastructure)** | agent | frontier | ADRs inside decided strategy; repository, data stores, runtimes, formats; build handoffs and done-criteria; accepting work in classes marked for review; operating procedures (e.g. database branch procedure) | technology evaluation, vendor and library docs, prior art | fit to intent, only for marked decision classes | ecosystem chief-of-staff |
| **Product and Design Lead** | agent | frontier | experience and interface design within decided product lines; microcopy within brand voice | users, comparable products, design references, accessibility | fit to experience intent for marked classes | ecosystem chief-of-staff |
| **Builder** | agent | workhorse-coding | how to implement within the handoff; implementation details, refactors within scope; shipping work that passes conformance (the reversible-work rule) | current docs, APIs, library versions, error messages, before and during coding | never its own work | architect |
| **Business Lead** | agent | frontier | market, pricing and financial research and models within strategy | markets, competitors, financial and regulatory sources | commercial claims in others' work on request | ecosystem chief-of-staff (money and legal go to founder) |
| **Operations and Finance Lead** | agent | frontier | keeping the spend register current from statements; flagging renewals, duplicates and unused subscriptions; moving existing commitments to the business card or account; budget-versus-actual reports | vendor pricing, plans and terms; banking and expense tools | cost and terms of proposed dependencies | founder for any new expense, plan upgrade, cancellation of an in-use service, or terms |

Checks with objective criteria (tests, goldens, invariants, rebuilds) run as CI and scripts: no model and no reviewer (the conformance rule).

## Decision rights (template)

| Class | Owner | Level | Condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| Accept work whose done-criteria pass conformance checks | builder | **decide** |  |
| Implementation choices inside a handoff | builder | **decide** |  |
| Schema or data change inside an accepted ADR, via the documented procedure | builder | **decide-inform** |  |
| Writes to the production database | builder | **decide-inform** | Only through the Architect's documented branch procedure |
| Narrowing permissions or closing a hole | builder | **decide-inform** |  |
| Widening permissions, new privileged paths | architect | **recommend-approve** | Marked for Architect review |
| New service, store, package boundary or format | architect | **decide-inform** | Requires an ADR; a second data store needs its own ADR |
| Deleting or rewriting records, dropping originals | architect | **recommend-approve** | Founder if it touches legal records or originals |
| An ADR consistent with ledger decisions | architect | **decide-inform** |  |
| Anything that would contradict an in-force ledger decision | founder | **escalate** |  |
| Adopting a free, open-licence dependency | architect | **decide-inform** | Add to the dependency register |
| Any paid service, plan change or purchase | founder | **escalate** |  |
| Accepting terms, licences with obligations, legal positions | founder | **escalate** |  |
| Who owns or controls the venture: admitting or removing a cofounder, issuing, granting or reclassifying shares or units, signing a SAFE, note or priced round, granting investor rights, forming a board or changing its powers, agreeing to sell or wind down. Founder decisions made with counsel (EE-022); agents prepare options and documents only | founder | **escalate** |  |
| Publishing, announcing, or sending anything outside on the company's behalf | founder | **escalate** |  |
| Release to production users | founder | **recommend-approve** | Founder or a named delegate |
| Strategy, product lineup, entity structure, methodology amendments | founder | **escalate** |  |
| A decision touching two ventures | chief-of-staff | **recommend-approve** | The chief of staff of the workspace (umbrella) position recommends; the founder approves |
| What a source says; whether a record is official | domain-lead | **decide-inform** |  |
| Experience and interface design within decided product lines | product-design-lead | **decide-inform** |  |
| Whether an idea is worked now or deferred, and to which role | chief-of-staff | **decide-inform** |  |
| Record statements, tag charges by entity, flag anomalies | operations-finance-lead | **decide** |  |
| Cancel, downgrade or change the plan of a paid service | operations-finance-lead | **recommend-approve** | Founder approves; Architect consulted if the service is in use |
| Move an existing subscription to the business card or account | operations-finance-lead | **recommend-approve** | Founder performs the change in the vendor account |

Levels: **decide**: Role decides; the work itself is the record; **decide-inform**: Role decides and records it (PR, register entry); founder may read, need not act; **recommend-approve**: Role recommends; the named approver decides (DACI); **escalate**: Founder decides (RAPID for the few with vetoes)
